Contractor shall also perform any additional services [CLIENT_NAME] reasonably requests during the Term at no additional charge.
findings.explanation: You are required to perform extra services requested by the client during the term without any additional pay. This exposes you to uncompensated work.
findings.suggested_change: The Client may request changes or additional services through a written change order, and any such extra work will be performed at agreed rates.

findings.quoted_text: [CLIENT_NAME] may request unlimited revisions until [CLIENT_NAME] is fully satisfied with each Deliverable.
findings.explanation: The client can demand an unlimited number of revisions for each deliverable until they are satisfied, without any extra compensation. This can lead to endless rework.
findings.suggested_change: The Client may request up to three rounds of revisions for each Deliverable, and any additional revisions will be billed at the Contractor's standard hourly rate.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, thank you for sending over the contract. Before signing the agreement, I would like to propose a couple of adjustments to the relevant clauses: - Regarding the requirement to perform additional services during the term at no extra charge, I propose that any extra work be requested through a written change order and performed at agreed rates. - Regarding the clause allowing unlimited revisions until satisfaction, I propose that the agreement specify a limit of three rounds of revisions per deliverable, with any additional revisions billed at the standard hourly rate. Thank you for your understanding. Best regards,
